changes.comment: When the process that the daemon ownership record names still runs but no daemon answers, say what that process is doing (on Linux, for example that a signal stopped it, that its socket is missing, or that it is not a Rush daemon) and what to do about it, instead of pointing to a reset that refuses while it runs. `connectOrAwaitDaemonStartupAsync()` no longer lets the caller run Rush in-process beside this workspace's Rush daemon (on Linux, the process that the ownership record names, which has that record open) when its socket file was deleted. Add `describeLiveDaemonOwner()`.
